tips.title: Your mission
tips.text: Each month is one level with one money skill. These are this month's steps. Tap a step to do it: it ticks off by itself.

tips.title: Company money
tips.text: What your company has now, and where it will end the month. ✓ = every cost gets paid. ✗ = something stays unpaid.

tips.title: Your home money
tips.text: Your personal account, separate from the company. Your bills are paid from here, so you have to pay yourself first.

tips.title: Actions
tips.text: Pay yourself from the company and plan your household budget. More actions unlock every month: the cushion in February, insurance in March.

tips.title: End month
tips.text: When you're ready, end the month. Every bill gets paid in order and the receipt shows what really happened.

tips.title: Your year
tips.text: Swipe right on the game screen to get here. 12 months, 12 lessons. You are in January.

tips.title: Your city
tips.text: Swipe left to get here. Good decisions build your home, company, cushion vault and protection. Unpaid bills bring rain, debt cracks the walls.

tips.title: Help and sound
tips.text: Tap ? to see this tour again. The speaker turns the sounds on and off.

tips.title: Watch out
tips.text: Something will go wrong during the month. A red alarm pops up and you decide how to deal with it. That's where you learn the most.

tips.title: What you get
tips.text: After the year you'll know how to keep a budget, build a cushion, protect yourself and grow your money. Each month ends with one step for your real life.

howItWorks.title: You learn by solving problems
howItWorks.sub: Every level follows the same 3 steps.

steps.title: Problem
steps.text: Something happens: a client pays late, a machine breaks, the market drops.

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: You choose what to do with real numbers. Every choice has a price, and you see it right away.

steps.title: Learn
steps.text: A short swipe lesson explains why it worked or not. Your city grows with every good decision.

howItWorks.yearTitle: Your year: 12 levels, one money skill each
howItWorks.knownNote: You already know the basics (budget, cushion, insurance), so we skip them. You can still play them later.
howItWorks.tapHint: Tap a month to start there.
howItWorks.notReadyText: This level is coming soon. You can start with January, August or a lesson month now.
